```{r libraries constants, include=F}
library(odbc)
library(DBI)
library(glue)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(dbplyr)
library(digest)
library(doParallel)

# dev and prod dsn strings
dev_dsn <- "OAO Cloud DB Staging"
prod_dsn <- "OAO Cloud DB Production"

# constants for how much history to query and current time of execution
x_days <- 90
query_date <- Sys.Date() - x_days
prod_con <- dbConnect(odbc(), prod_dsn)
paycycle <- tbl(prod_con, "LPM_MAPPING_PAYCYCLE") %>% 
  collect() %>%
  mutate(PAYCYCLE_DATE = as.Date(PAYCYCLE_DATE)) %>%
  filter(PAYCYCLE_DATE >= as.Date(query_date))
query_date <- min(paycycle$PP_START_DATE)
start_time <- Sys.time()

# function for creating insert statements on LPM_RAD_PREMIER
get_values_premier <- function(source_table, destination_schema, destination_table) {
  
    CORPORATION_CODE <- source_table[1]  #VARCHAR(6 char)
    ENTITY_CODE      <- source_table[2]  #VARCAHR(6 char)
    COSTCENTER       <- source_table[3]  #VARCAHR(15 char)
    PP_START_DATE    <- source_table[4]  #DATE
    PP_END_DATE      <- source_table[5]  #DATE
    CPT4             <- source_table[6]  #VARCHAR(15 char)
    SERVICE_DATE     <- source_table[7]  #NUMERIC
    ACTUAL_VOLUME    <- source_table[8]  #DATE
    UNIQUE_ID        <- source_table[9]  #VARCHAR(50 char)
    DATE_ADDED       <- source_table[10] #DATE
    
    values <- glue("INTO {glue::double_quote(destination_schema)}.{glue::double_quote(destination_table)}
                   (CORPORATION_CODE, ENTITY_CODE , COSTCENTER, PP_START_DATE, PP_END_DATE, CPT4, 
                   SERVICE_DATE, ACTUAL_VOLUME, UNIQUE_ID, DATE_ADDED)
                 
                   VALUES ('{CORPORATION_CODE}', '{ENTITY_CODE}', '{COSTCENTER}', 
                   TO_DATE('{PP_START_DATE}', 'yyyy-mm-dd'), TO_DATE('{PP_END_DATE}', 'yyyy-mm-dd'), 
                   '{CPT4}', TO_DATE('{SERVICE_DATE}', 'yyyy-mm-dd'), '{ACTUAL_VOLUME}', '{UNIQUE_ID}',
                   TO_DATE('{DATE_ADDED}', 'yyyy-mm-dd'))")
    
    return(values)
}
```

# Truncate Staging
```{r truncate staging, echo=FALSE}
truncate_upload <- glue("TRUNCATE TABLE LPM_RAD_PREMIER_STAGING;")

# execute mapping table merge statements
dev_con <- dbConnect(odbc(), dev_dsn)
dbBegin(dev_con)

# execute statements and if there is an error  with one of them rollback changes
tryCatch({
  dbExecute(dev_con, truncate_upload)
  print("LPM_RAD_UPLOAD_STAGING has been truncated")
  
  dbCommit(dev_con)
  dbDisconnect(dev_con)
  
  print(paste0(Sys.time(), ": Staging Table Truncated Successfully"))
  }, 
  error = function(err){
    dbRollback(dev_con)
    dbDisconnect(dev_con)
    print("Error")
    }
  )
```

# Data Pull
```{r combined data pull, echo=FALSE}
# prod connection
prod_con <- dbConnect(odbc(), prod_dsn)

premier_insert <- glue(
  "WITH RAD_JOINED AS (
   SELECT
        rad.*,
        paycycle.PP_START_DATE,
        paycycle.PP_END_DATE,
        cc.COSTCENTER,
        support.SUPPORT,
        '729805' as CORPORATION_CODE,
        CASE WHEN support.SUPPORT IN ('MSH', 'MSQ') THEN 'NY0014'
             WHEN support.SUPPORT IN ('MSB', 'MSUS', 'CCW') THEN '630571'
             WHEN support.SUPPORT = 'MSW' THEN 'NY2162'
             WHEN support.SUPPORT = 'MSM' THEN 'NY2163'
        END ENTITY_CODE
   FROM LPM_RAD_COMBINED rad
   LEFT JOIN LPM_MAPPING_PAYCYCLE paycycle ON rad.SERVICE_DATE = paycycle.PAYCYCLE_DATE
   LEFT JOIN LPM_RAD_MAPPING_COSTCENTER cc ON rad.RESOURCE_NAME = cc.RESOURCE_NAME
   LEFT JOIN LPM_RAD_MAPPING_SUPPORT support ON rad.RESOURCE_NAME = support.RESOURCE_NAME
   WHERE cc.COSTCENTER IS NOT NULL AND
         rad.SERVICE_DATE >= DATE \'{query_date}\')
   SELECT
        CORPORATION_CODE,
        ENTITY_CODE,
        COSTCENTER,
        PP_START_DATE,
        PP_END_DATE,
        CPT4,
        SERVICE_DATE,
        COUNT(*) as ACTUAL_VOLUME
   FROM RAD_JOINED
   GROUP BY
        CORPORATION_CODE,
        ENTITY_CODE,
        COSTCENTER,
        PP_START_DATE,
        PP_END_DATE,
        CPT4,
        SERVICE_DATE;")


# create, execute and clear result for premier radiant query
premier_insert_query <- dbSendQuery(prod_con, premier_insert)
radiant_premier <- dbFetch(premier_insert_query)
dbClearResult(premier_insert_query)

# add unique ID and date added columns
radiant_premier <- radiant_premier %>%
  mutate(
    SERVICE_DATE = as.character(as.Date(SERVICE_DATE)),
    PP_END_DATE = as.character(as.Date(PP_END_DATE)),
    PP_START_DATE = as.character(as.Date(PP_START_DATE)),
    UNIQUE_ID = 
    paste0(CORPORATION_CODE, ENTITY_CODE, COSTCENTER, PP_START_DATE,
           PP_END_DATE, SERVICE_DATE),
    DATE_ADDED = as.character(Sys.Date()))
radiant_premier$UNIQUE_ID <- sapply(radiant_premier$UNIQUE_ID, digest, algo="md5")
  
print(paste0(Sys.time(), ": Premier Data Pulled Successfully"))
```

# Insert Staging Table
```{r radiant premier staging, echo=FALSE}
rad_premier_schema <- "OAO_DEVELOPMENT"
rad_premier_table <- "LPM_RAD_PREMIER_STAGING"
# convert the each record/row of tibble to INTO clause of insert statement
inserts <- 
  lapply(
    lapply(
      lapply(split(radiant_premier, 
                   1:nrow(radiant_premier)),
             as.list),
      as.character),
    FUN = get_values_premier, rad_premier_schema, rad_premier_table)

# create batches of inserts for insert statements
chunk_length <- 250
split_queries <- split(inserts, ceiling(seq_along(inserts)/chunk_length))

# append each batch of inserts to batch insert list
split_queries_values <- list()
for (i in 1:length(split_queries)) {
  row <- glue_collapse(split_queries[[i]], sep = "\n\n")
  values <- glue('INSERT ALL
               {row}
               SELECT 1 from DUAL;')
  split_queries_values <- append(split_queries_values, values)
}

# execute parallel inserts of 250 record chunks
registerDoParallel()
outputPar <- foreach(i = 1:length(split_queries_values), 
                     .packages = c("DBI", "odbc")) %dopar% {
                       dev_con <- dbConnect(odbc(), dev_dsn)
                       tryCatch({
                         dbBegin(dev_con)
                         dbExecute(dev_con, split_queries_values[[i]])
                         dbCommit(dev_con)
                         dbDisconnect(dev_con)
                       },
                       error = function(err){
                         print("error")
                         dbRollback(dev_con)
                         dbDisconnect(dev_con)
                       })
                     }
registerDoSEQ()
print(paste0(Sys.time(), ": Premier rad data has been added to LPM_RAD_PREMIER_STAGING"))
```
